ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Ashapuri Gold Ornament Limited reported a robust Q2 H1 FY'26, achieving significant year-on-year growth across key metrics including 20% sales volume, 18% total income, doubled EBITDA, and 145% PAT, driven by higher volumes, premium product mix, and design innovation. While the company maintains a 100% gold hedging policy and secured a strong order book, its FY'26 revenue growth guidance was materially revised downwards to 20-25% from an initial 45-50% due to surging gold prices. Management emphasizes quantity-led growth and is strategically focusing on bulk orders and premium segments to sustain future performance.
